name: house_01

collision.note: South door at local (3,7)–(4,7). The doorway sits mostly in column 3 with a 10 px spill into column 4; both south cells are left open. Plan variant may move the door to N/E/W.

note: Scaled so the door opening is 194×132 px: about 19% taller than the elf body (162 px) and wider than human/dwarf shoulders (74 px). The previous 3×3 / 384×384 cottage had a 70×48 px door, too short and too narrow. The roof is drawn inside the 8×8 canvas in 3/4 (same convention as the old 3×3), not extending above the footprint. This is larger than the OBJECTS-PLAN house_small 3×3 (and house_large 4×4); lots will need updating.
